text:
alice: Quick heads-up — we're starting a staged rollout for structured output / function-calling compat flags today. Posting plan + asks for eng-platform, SDK, and infra checks. @eng-oncall :eyes:

alice: Plan (high-level):
• 5% canary (internal + beta orgs) -> monitor 24h
• 25% expand to opt-in customers with client SDK >= 2.3.0
• 100% enable server-side compat for requests that pass schema.

alice: Flags we will flip (names): `so_compat_v1`, `fncall_compat_v1`, and an SDK-surface toggle `client_so_mode`.

alice: Example config we plan to push to flags service:
```
so_compat_v1: staged
fncall_compat_v1: staged
client_so_mode: legacy-by-default
canary_audience: internal,beta
canary_pct: 5
schema_validation: fail-open
```

ben: A few quick q's — what does `legacy-by-default` mean for older SDKs that haven't shipped client behavior? Will they error or fall back?

carla: Good call. We should avoid hard errors for old SDKs. Suggest we add a server-side fallback: if client header absent, treat as legacy and return text-only (no structured payload). Add metric for schema-mismatch.

dmitri: I'm adding telemetry for `so.schema_failures` and `so.fallback_used`. We'll emit tags: `org_id`, `model`, `route`. Also exposing a sample payload (masked) for investigation.

sophia: Canary audiences — let's ensure product/beta org list is up to date. I'll sync with Growth to make sure no publicly-visible customers are in this group. Also recommend we run a short UX script with support on standby.

jamie: SDK PR is ready at https://git.redwood/infer/sdk/pull/482 — switches `client_so_mode` from `legacy` to `opt-in` in 2.3.0 and adds `X-Client-SO: enabled` header when user opts in. Need eng-platform to confirm header semantics.

ben: Ok — so server behavior: if `X-Client-SO: enabled` + `so_compat_v1` on -> return structured output. If header missing but flag on -> do not error, return legacy text. That keeps clients safe.

carla: Guardrails checklist from my side:
• schema validation run but `fail-open` initially
• max keys / depth enforcement (reject huge payloads)
• per-route opt-out config (some routes are incompatible)
• automated regression alert (quality drop on eval prompts)

alice: +1. Also adding an automatic rollback trigger: if `so.fallback_used` > 3% of calls in canary for 2 consecutive hours, flag flips back to previous state and oncall paged.

infra-bot: Deploy window reserved at 11:30 UTC. Rollback command: `redwood flags set so_compat_v1 off --env prod` — runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/so-rollout

deploy-bot: Canary deploy job queued: job/so-canary-17662. Notifying observability hooks.

ben: One more: migration docs — we need a small migration guide in the SDK release notes explaining header + sample code snippet to opt-in. I'll draft and ping docs.

carla: I'll add an E2E test that simulates schema mismatch and ensures fail-open behavior in the canary environment.

alice: Thanks all. Action items:
• jamie -> merge SDK PR and bump release notes (today)
• dmitri -> wire telemetry + dashboards (by EOD)
• sophia -> confirm beta org list (1h)
• carla -> add E2E and guardrail tests (before canary)
• infra -> hold prod flag change until 11:30 UTC

alice: I'll flip `so_compat_v1` to `staged` at 11:30 and post results here. Ping me if you want to be added to the canary audience. :shipit:

ben: LGTM, thanks. :thumbsup:

sophia: ack — standing by for any support requests.

dmitri: telemetry dashboards link: https://dashboards.redwood/so-canary (will populate within 10m).

alice: tagging @eng-oncall again — please monitor.

jamie: merging SDK PR now, will post CI results.

deploy-bot: CI passed for sdk@2.3.0; release artifact uploaded.

alice: final — minute-by-minute check-ins not required unless alert fires. We'll reconvene tomorrow for 24h retrospective.
